content: {"rule": "K-S2", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "It treats the lack of explicit textual resolution of paternity as a reason to mark Romans 1:3 UNDERDETERMINED, which is the kind of single-verse non-statement ground K-S2 forbids.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] section A.1-2 and [CR3] Link 6 premises 1-3, where descent according to the flesh is weighed against conception of the Holy Ghost without explicit textual resolution of paternity.", "rule_words": "That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.", "room": "a single verse does not state a link or its contrary — read narrowly as barring only an express single-verse non-statement rationale, or broadly as barring UNDERDETERMINED whenever the judge cites lack of explicit textual resolution; I adopt the broad reading.", "why": "The judge marks the issue UNDERDETERMINED expressly because there is no explicit textual resolution of paternity, making single-verse non-statement and unresolved dual sense a ground for UNDERDETERMINED contrary to K-S2."}
